_source: Proposal No. 1, Tables 3a, 3b and 4. SMS templates use {h} (level, m) and {r} (rate, m/min).

ADVISE.sms_team: ADVISORY: Flood level at {h} m, preparation range. Standby for possible evacuation.

SURGE.voice: ON, rapid-rise evacuation announcement on loop
SURGE.sms_team: RAPID RISE ALERT: Level {h} m, rising at {r} m/min. Initiate immediate evacuation procedures.
SURGE.sms_public: FLOOD WARNING: Water levels are rising rapidly. Evacuate to higher ground immediately.

ALARM.sms_team: EVACUATION ORDER: Level {h} m. Begin evacuation procedures now.
ALARM.sms_public: FLOOD EMERGENCY: Evacuate to higher ground immediately.

SILENT.sms_team: Siren and voice silenced. Evacuation order still in force. Level {h} m.
SILENT.sms_public: Evacuation order remains in effect. Do not return.

FORCED.sms_team: FORCED EVACUATION: Level {h} m has reached or exceeded the 18 m critical threshold. Execute emergency evacuation procedures immediately.
FORCED.sms_public: MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER: Critical flood level reached. Leave the affected area immediately and proceed to designated evacuation centers.

HOLD.sms_public: Water level is falling. Remain evacuated until further notice.
